seo.template: Run the Claude SEO workflow the user requests. Load the `seo` skill (orchestrator) plus the relevant sub-skill for the requested command type. If the user passes a URL or topic as arguments, use it. Follow the skill's orchestration: spawn the matching subagents from .opencode/agent/ in parallel, run bundled scripts via the claude-seo runtime, and produce a prioritized markdown report with falsifiability checks per recommendation.
